band_assignment.statistic: ground-truth delta_od (falling back to the ground truth's declared lab_band when delta_od is missing)
band_assignment.outer_edges: opened to -/+inf so the bands partition the line; the derived file declares the lowest edge at its measured minimum

selection_bias_delta.note: Recovery conditioned on the pipeline's own verdict. The gap is selection, not accuracy: the rejected curves are the ones fitted worst, so any tightening of a gate raises accepted_good_rmse's flattery without changing the estimator.

uncertainty.note: Do the pipeline's own error bars cover the truth?
uncertainty.estimand_note: coverage_95 is the raw nominal-interval coverage; centered_coverage_95 removes each parameter's median signed error and therefore isolates the spread from the estimand mismatch.

a_not_identifiable.rule: correct if the pipeline rejected the curve, OR |A_fit - observed final OD| / observed final OD <= 0.15 and A_fit <= 1.20 x the last observed point

preprocessing_blind.reason: write_legacy_csvs (tecan_growth/preprocess.py:81-93) emits the replicate mean only, so these curves are unpassable with the current gate set; a headline drop caused by them would be uninterpretable.

run_length_robustness.reason: data_dir not supplied; pass --data-dir to compute this block

degenerate_covariance.definition: a_err_pct is inf (singular covariance at a bound)
